Front Desk Cash Drawer Control

Control front desk cash with complete accountability. THEHOTEL360 tracks opening balance, collections, paid outs, refunds, expected cash, actual cash, variance, drawer closing, and cash handover. Every cash movement is connected with operational and accounting control.

Learn more →

Cash, Bank & Gateway Settlement Control

THEHOTEL360 helps hotels track cash, bank, card, mobile banking, and payment gateway collections clearly. Verify pending settlements, bank deposits, gateway charges, and net settled amounts with proper accounting control.
